:::::: {.home}

::::: {.hero}
[Data scientist building ML systems that ship, and the occasional causal-inference rabbit hole.]{.tagline}

Three years of production ML in banking, plus work in fintech and logistics. At the Bank of the Philippine Islands I built forecasting and credit models used by leadership, and an MLOps library used by 50+ data scientists. I'm now finishing an MS in Data Science at Boston University.

[[GitHub](https://github.com/aadpaguio) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arnald-paguio-782907162) · [Email](mailto:adpaguio@bu.edu)]{.links}

[Selected work]{.home-label}

:::: {.body .entries}
::: {.entry}
[The new manager bounce](blog/new-manager-bounce/){.entry-title}

Does sacking a manager improve results? Coarsened exact matching on 585 sackings across 20 seasons of Europe's top five leagues.

[Finding: the effect is essentially zero over 3, 5, and 8 matches.]{.result}
:::

::: {.entry}
[bpi-standard-ml](https://github.com/aadpaguio/bpi-standard-ml-demo){.entry-title}

A Python MLOps library that standardized preprocessing, training, Optuna tuning, and experiment tracking at BPI.

[Used by 50+ data scientists; cut development-to-deployment time by about 70%.]{.result}
:::

::: {.entry}
[Marginalia](https://github.com/aadpaguio/Marginalia){.entry-title}

A local-first EPUB reader with an AI reading partner that looks up book context through tool calls instead of reading the full text, which cuts hallucinations and avoids spoilers.

[Three retrieval tiers compared with an LLM judge across 3 books × 15 prompts.]{.result}
:::

::: {.entry}
[Routing frozen experts with contextual bandits](https://github.com/aadpaguio/moe_contextual_bandits){.entry-title}

A LinUCB router that learns which frozen specialist model should handle each input, instead of sending everything through one large model.

[Better cumulative decisions than a supervised router, despite picking the exact best expert 2.3× less often.]{.result}
:::
